results.name: cohortObservedEffect
results.regime: 2e6 individuals in 20 independent blocks of 1e5, standardised dosage so the marginal OLS slope IS the effect; the phenotype is built as (genetic * modifier) * dosage + noise. The modifier is swept across 1, the only value where a sum and a product coincide, and one cell gives the genetic effect a NEGATIVE sign. What is measured is that the body is the right function OF the declared multiplicative interaction, not that the interaction is multiplicative
